thread:
Maya: quick PM follow-up from today's postmortem — we need clear owners and dates for tests/evals driven by the KV-eviction pattern. Short items: regression harness, incident promptset, staging burst job, and a scoped chaos drill.
Priya: I can take the promptset + evals. I'll extract representative traces and add ~20 labeled prompts (truncated-prefix, kv-miss cascade, mem-pressure). ETA 2025-04-11.
Leo: I'll build the regression harness and CI jobs: fast PR subset + nightly full run. Plan to tag tests with severity (critical/high/medium). ETA 2025-04-01.
Maya: I'll own the staging load profile and the initial chaos drill orchestration. Proposal: weekly burst job in staging + monthly small blast-radius cross-region drill. Need runbook + abort steps. ETA infra-as-code 2025-04-09.
Priya: evals will include p95/p99, token-drop, and a small quality overlap metric. I'll add minimal repro scripts and golden responses.
Leo: gating idea: tests marked critical/high should block release; medium advisory. We'll flip from advisory->blocking after coverage >= 80% of incident cases.
Maya: agreed. Also want a detector rule to feed the weekly "pattern-watch" digest: suggestion: eviction_rate > 5% AND p95_latency > 2x baseline => add digest row. If digest shows >=3 similar incidents in 14 days, auto-create a triage ticket.
Priya: noted. I'll add severity labels to prompts and root-cause tags so the digest can roll up counts.
OpsBot: ticket INF-9001 created: "KV-eviction promptset & evals" -> Priya, due 2025-04-11.
OpsBot: ticket INF-9002 created: "KV-eviction regression harness" -> Leo, due 2025-04-01.
OpsBot: ticket INF-9003 created: "Staging burst + chaos drill" -> Maya, due 2025-04-09.
Maya: scheduling a 25m sync on 2025-03-29 13:00 UTC to review first PRs and the promptset. Invite owners. Please update ticket comments with blockers. :thumbsup:
Leo: quick snippet for the PR job name pattern so history aggregates: releases/kv-evict/{pr,nightly}.
Priya: I'll push the promptset PR with labels and a small README showing repro steps.
Maya: great. let's keep digest outputs posted to #eng-sre and link tickets in the release dashboard. Thanks all.
OpsBot: calendar event created: "KV-eviction remediation check-in" 2025-03-29 13:00 UTC (invite sent).
